csv_project_name: Developers for Boston Restore Rebuild Projects
csv_scope_of_work: The Boston Housing Authority is soliciting proposals from qualified, licensed, and insured developers or owners of new multifamily rental construction, or multifamily properties requiring rehabilitation, who are interested in developing public housing units using HUD s mixed finance program with pre-approval to convert the units to a long term Section 8 contract. All proposals submitted in response to this solicitation must conform to all the requirements and specifications outlined within the RFP and any designated attachments in its entirety.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering

title: Developers for Boston Restore Rebuild Projects
short_description: Developer solicitation for multifamily public housing new construction and rehabilitation in Boston.
project_scope: Solicitation for qualified developers or owners of new multifamily rental construction or multifamily properties requiring rehabilitation to develop public housing units under HUD's mixed finance program, with pre-approval for conversion of the units to a long-term Section 8 contract. The notice covers both new construction and rehabilitation/refurbishment of multifamily housing properties in Boston. No gross floor area, unit count, or other technical size parameters are stated.
services: Design-build/developer services for multifamily housing development and rehabilitation, with requested disciplines including civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fire protection engineering, and utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Multifamily housing project; building type is generally not a core sbp focus unless especially large or complex.
- Notice is primarily aimed at developers/owners rather than specialist structural designers.
- Includes structural engineering among requested disciplines, but no specific complex structural challenge is described.
- No spans, special structures, long-span roofs, bridges, stadiums, or innovative lightweight construction elements are indicated.
- Strategic relevance is limited because this is a broad housing development/rehabilitation solicitation.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. Useful known information: public housing development and rehabilitation in Boston under HUD mixed-finance and Section 8 conversion framework; includes new multifamily construction and rehabilitation, but no unit count, area, or scope quantities are provided, so no realistic cost estimate can be derived from the source alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice is for developer/design-build type proposals and does not define a separate structural engineering fee basis, project size, or construction budget, so no realistic sbp fee estimate can be made from the source alone.
references_qualifications: Qualified, licensed, and insured developers or owners of new multifamily rental construction, or multifamily properties requiring rehabilitation. Additional detailed reference requirements are not stated in the source excerpt.
contracting_authority: Boston Housing Authority, Boston, MA, USA. Contact: Joel Wool. Phone: 617-988-4000. Fax: 617-988-4292. Email: bids@bostonhousing.org. Website: https://www.bostonhousing.org/en/Bid-Opportunities/Current-Bid-Opportunities/RFP-2449-01-Restore-Rebuild-Projects-in-City-of.aspx
notes: Project number 2449-01. Target market listed as General Building. Stage: RFP/RFQ. County: Suffolk. No submission deadline set in the source. Source indicates solicitation documents are available online.
